**Finding submitted: deviation (GOVLAW)**

- **Issue:** § 28.1 (p0103) picks Singapore law and exclusive Singapore courts — outside the accepted list (NY, DE, CA, England & Wales) and squarely in walk-away territory. It also conflicts head-on with § 28.2 (p0104), which already gives exclusive jurisdiction to the state and federal courts in New York County.
- **Redline (validated ok:true):** § 28.1 now reads "…governed by the laws of the State of New York, without regard to its conflict-of-laws rules, and jurisdiction and venue are as set out in Section 28.2." Only the jurisdiction and forum words changed; § 28.2's submission/waiver language and injunctive-relief carve-out, and § 28.3's escalation step, are untouched and acceptable.
